description: Every line a verb or a bin/lib module prints for the user goes through out() from bin/lib/output-sink.ts: never process.stdout.write, console.log/info/debug/dir/table, or the process.stdout stream handed around as a value (`(ok ? process.stdout : process.stderr).write(…)`, `output: process.stdout`); reading process.stdout.isTTY / columns / rows is fine. The MCP server runs the same verbs in-process (pensmith_plan / pensmith_write / pensmith_verify) and speaks JSON-RPC on stdout, so it points the sink at stderr before it connects, and pensmith_status captures it with withCapturedOutput(); a direct write would corrupt the frame (T1-15). The CLI keeps the default sink, the process's stdout, so its output is byte-identical. bin/lib/pdf-worker.ts is exempt: it runs in a worker thread whose console goes to the worker's own captured stream, which pdf-text.ts never forwards (SEC-02). The hook entries in hooks/ are out of scope: their stdout is the hook protocol.
